name: Alt Spam
description: Automatic alternating-input (alt spam) trainer with 5/7 bursts, CPS, delay, buffer and presets.

cps.name: Clicks per second
cps.description: How fast it clicks. 20 is a good start, 30+ is very fast.

intensity.name: Intensity (%)
intensity.description: Turns the click speed down or up. 100 = full speed, 50 = half.

continuous.name: Nonstop mode
continuous.description: ON = click nonstop. OFF = click in short bursts with a pause between them.

burst-size.name: Clicks per burst
burst-size.description: Burst mode only: how many alternating clicks (left, right, left...) before the pause. 5 and 7 are the usual ones - switch with the < > arrows on the panel.

frequency.name: Bursts per second
frequency.description: Burst mode only: how many bursts start each second. Lower = longer pause between bursts.

continue-alt.name: Keep alternating between bursts
continue-alt.description: ON = the next burst starts on the opposite side. OFF = every burst starts on the same side.

ramp-ms.name: Speed-up time (ms)
ramp-ms.description: Starts slow and reaches full speed over this time. 0 = instant.

hold-ratio.name: Click hold length (%)
hold-ratio.description: How long each click is held down. Lower = shorter taps.

split-dual.name: Right side controls Player 2
split-dual.description: In dual mode, left clicks Player 1 and right clicks Player 2.

input-delay.name: Input delay (ms)
input-delay.description: Waits this long before every click.

lane-offset.name: Right-side extra delay (ms)
lane-offset.description: Delays only the right-side clicks by this much.

buffer-ms.name: Buffer (ms)
buffer-ms.description: A click due within this window fires early instead of waiting a frame. 0 = exact.

jitter.name: Randomness (ms)
jitter.description: Adds a small random +/- to each click time.

countdown-ms.name: Start delay (ms)
countdown-ms.description: Waits this long after each attempt starts before clicking.

auto-stop-sec.name: Auto-stop (seconds)
auto-stop-sec.description: Stops clicking after this long each attempt. 0 = never.

show-taps.name: Show taps
show-taps.description: Shows a glowing circle on screen every time it clicks (left side = cyan, right side = pink).

hud.name: Show control panel
hud.description: The small AS button in the level that opens the controls.

hud-scale.name: Panel size
hud-scale.description: Make the panel buttons bigger or smaller.

hud-side.name: Panel side
hud-side.description: Which side of the screen the panel is on.

auto-arm.name: Start automatically
auto-arm.description: Starts clicking as soon as each attempt begins.
